scripts.text:
[Guild Clerk]
The Emperium to be distributed to the guild office today has arrived. If you want to purchase, please put as many as you want~
scripts.translation:
[公會職員]
今天供給公會辦事處的華麗金屬到貨了，想買多少就選多少吧~

scripts.text:
[Guild Clerk]
It seems that many people are looking for Emperium today. It's just a personal feeling.
scripts.translation:
[公會職員]
總覺得今天來找華麗金屬的人特別多，個人感覺而已。

scripts.text:
[Guild Clerk]
Our guild office actively supports the smooth gathering of adventurers.
scripts.translation:
[公會職員]
公會辦事處會積極幫助冒險者們順利組建公會。

scripts.text:
[Guild Clerk]
As part of that,
we are selling a limited quantity of 100 {0} every day
from ^0000ff18:00 to 23:59^000000 from ^0000ffMonday to Saturday^000000.
scripts.translation:
[公會職員]
作為其中一部分，我們每天限量出售100個{0}，營業時間為^0000ff18:00至23:59^000000，銷售日為^0000ff週一至週六^000000。

scripts.text:
[Guild Clerk]
Please note that our guild office does not sell all the time because we have to run around to supply Emperium outside of the hours.
scripts.translation:
[公會職員]
其餘時間還得四處採購華麗金屬，所以不是全天出售，還請留意。
